response.sql: WITH telescope_averages AS (SELECT "telescref", AVG("modindex") AS avg_modindex FROM "signals" WHERE "modindex" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "telescref"), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS overall_avg FROM telescope_averages) SELECT t."telescref", t.avg_modindex, t.avg_modindex - o.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg, t.avg_modindex / NULLIF(o.overall_avg, 0) AS ratio FROM telescope_averages AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE t.avg_modindex > o.overall_avg ORDER BY ratio DESC, t."telescref" ASC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A telescope with no nonmissing modulation index is excluded because its average is undefined. If the overall average is zero, the ratio is NULL.
